patch_description: Replacing the RY and RZ gates with a full RZ-RY-RZ sequence implements an arbitrary local single-qubit rotation (U3) via Euler angles. This provides maximum expressiveness per qubit within the ansatz before the entangling CZ operations. Additionally, by modifying the entanglement map from a line (or disjoint pairs) to a full contiguous ring (i.e., nearest neighbor CZ gates with periodic boundary conditions), entanglement is symmetrically distributed across all 8 qubits. This approach quadruples the number of trainable Z-rotations relative to the Y-rotations in the block without significantly increasing depth.
